conditions_on_agent_7.title: the 25th candidate is rate-dependent; 24 is an acceptable outcome
conditions_on_agent_7.detail: the loop terminates on iteration count (N=640), not on 12 active hours. At Agent 4's own measured 67.404 s/iteration, 640 iterations is 43139 s = 11.983 active hours, which is 61 s short of the h12 boundary at 43,200 s, yielding 24 candidates (ordinals 0-23, last at h11.5). Agent 4B's smoke averaged 67.995 s/iteration, which would reach 43517 s and produce all 25. The outcome turns on whether production averages above or below 67.5 s.
conditions_on_agent_7.instruction: Record the actual count under Agent 7 section 6's 'or account explicitly for each missing ordinal'. A 24-candidate run is NOT an integrity failure and must not be treated as a stop. Do NOT extend the run past N iterations to manufacture the 25th: the move LR and entropy schedules are horizoned to this N, and contract section 9 forbids recomputing the horizon from production speed.

conditions_on_agent_7.title: D10-ADV-SCALE remains uncompensated
conditions_on_agent_7.detail: the printed setup advantage puts alpha*(I - h) in nats against an outcome term bounded by 2. Agent 4B's smoke measured an entropy-to-outcome magnitude ratio of 2.84 at iteration 1 (2.70 vs 0.999). D10 section 4 ships this deliberately and forbids a compensating scale, floor, centering rule or controller.
conditions_on_agent_7.instruction: record the component magnitudes as telemetry. Do not tune. This is an experiment result, not a defect to repair mid-run.
